novelty_flags.label: thm:finite-sample-whole-set-coverage
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed finite-sample propagation of a simultaneous observable-law region to confidence bounds for the population sharp interval is already covered by Duarte et al.'s general discrete-program inference construction.

novelty_flags.label: thm:finite-sample-whole-set-coverage gap and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited JASA version places the propagation argument in Section 6 with formal details in Appendix E, not Section 7 and Appendix C as claimed.

soundness_flags.label: thm:sharp-selective-label-interval
soundness_flags.one_line: Once the finite response-type reduction is granted, equality with [L(p),U(p)] and endpoint attainment are the defining LP extrema plus compactness, a 1--2-step reduction that caps this statement at field unless augmented by a substantive characterization.

soundness_flags.label: prop:z-blind-containment
soundness_flags.one_line: The containment follows immediately because every v with Bv=p also satisfies K_blind Bv=K_blind p; it is a pure definition unfold rather than a root research result.

soundness_flags.label: prop:trialed-policy-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: A_c=1 for every configuration reveals Z but does not make an untrialed c_e equal any trialed c_j, so it does not by itself reduce the general construction to ordinary randomized-trial identification.
